title: How the batteries hand over to the generator
alt: Section through a data centre's electrical room. The grid cable from the street goes grey when the grid fails; the batteries beside the UPS carry the racks; out in the yard a large generator starts and puffs exhaust, and its cable under the yard comes alive to the switchgear.
sources: kit3d SPEC: switchgear, ups, battery, rack, genset (Rehlko KD2000, 13.493 m enclosure)
camera: face-on section; starts at the street feed and the electrical room, moves to the yard as the generator starts, then pulls back over the whole path

steps.caption: The grid feeds the switchgear, the UPS and the racks.
When the grid fails, the UPS batteries carry the racks at once.
Out in the yard, the standby generator starts.
The generator takes over, through the switchgear.
